🔥 Data Engineer Interview Prep? Read This Before Your Friday Interview! 🔥
If you’ve got a Data Engineer interview lined up this Friday, don’t just revise — prepare smart.
Here are some high-impact questions that interviewers LOVE (and candidates often underestimate):
_______________________________________________________________
💡 1. How would you design a data pipeline from scratch?
👉 Tip: Talk about ingestion → processing → storage → orchestration → monitoring. Mention tools like Airflow, Kafka, Spark.

💡 2. Batch vs Real-Time Processing — when to use what?
👉 Show clarity, not confusion. Use real-world examples.

💡 3. How do you handle schema evolution in production pipelines?
👉 This separates beginners from pros. Mention backward/forward compatibility.

💡 4. Explain partitioning & bucketing in big data systems
👉 Bonus points if you connect it with query performance optimization.

💡 5. What happens when your pipeline fails at 2 AM?
👉 Interviewers want to hear: alerting, retry logic, logging, and root cause analysis.

💡 6. Difference between Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse
👉 Keep it simple, structured, and business-focused.

💡 7. How do you ensure data quality?
👉 Talk about validation checks, anomaly detection, SLAs.

💡 8. SQL Challenge (Almost Guaranteed)
👉 Practice window functions, joins, and aggregations.
____________________________________________________________

📌 Still preparing for interviews with random questions?
That’s exactly why most people don’t make it.
Real interviews are scenario-based, messy, and pressure-driven.
And most prep content doesn’t reflect that.
